relations.quote: It is built inside a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md).

Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $D=h^3$ (the label space dimension).

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$, called a triple, $t_T$ is its indicator vector, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: neighbor triple
symbols.meaning: A triple, paired with $T$ as a neighbor when $|T\cap S|=1$.

symbols.name: triple set
symbols.meaning: The set of all three-element subsets of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For a three-element subset $T$ of $[h]$, called a triple, $t_T$ is its indicator vector, and $\mathcal T$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: triple value
symbols.meaning: The value carried by a triple $T$, written $g_T$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The central wire of element $e$, which carries the sum of the $g_T$ over triples $T$ containing $e$.
symbols.quote: Over $\mathbb F_2$, gather puts the sum of the $g_T$ with $T\ni e$ on a central wire $C_e$ for each element $e$, and scatter adds $\sum_{e\in S}C_e$ to the target $S$.

symbols.name: auxiliary wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire for a neighbor pair $S,T$, which carries a copy of $g_T$.
symbols.quote: A copy of $g_T$ on an auxiliary wire $A_{ST}$ for each neighbor pair, injected back into $S$, adds $1$ exactly when $|S\cap T|=1$.

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The space $(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ in which labels live.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $D=h^3$ (the label space dimension).

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space $\mathcal F$, which is $h^3$.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, a space built from the [tensor product of vector spaces](tensor-product-of-vector-spaces.md) of three copies of $\mathbb Q^h$, of dimension $D=h^3$ (the label space dimension).

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: A nondegenerate subspace of the label space, attached to a gate, sink or source.
symbols.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.

symbols.name: source index
symbols.meaning: A triple of triples $(T_1,T_2,T_3)$, indexing a source and its label $U_\iota$.
symbols.quote: For an index $\iota=(T_1,T_2,T_3)\in\mathcal T^3$, the label $U_\iota$ is the line spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the label $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$.
symbols.quote: Give each gate or sink with label $U$ the projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, and the source of index $\iota$ the matrix $-P_{U_\iota}$.

symbols.name: total rank
symbols.meaning: The total rank of the edge matrices over all edges, which counts the smaller calls.
symbols.quote: Let $s$, the total rank over all edges, change meaning here.

symbols.name: index count
symbols.meaning: The number of indices $\iota$, equal to $\binom h3^3$.
symbols.quote: Let $N=\binom h3^3$, the number of indices $\iota$ (the letter $N$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be the total dimension lost on decreasing edges (the letter $L$ changes meaning here).
